name: Milrem THeMIS
armament: Unarmed cargo/casevac, or RWS with MG, 40 mm AGL, 30 mm cannon, ATGM or loitering-munition launchers
protection: Unarmoured. Game: small arms can disable sensors; 7.62x54R and larger destroy it.
visual_notes: Small tracked robot: two track pods with a flat cargo deck or weapon station mounted between them
Sensor mast at the front; low profile (about 1.15 m)
Used for casualty evacuation and resupply in Ukraine
